architecture.mechanism: Substituting clean energy for fossil fuels — energy is substituted from an external clean source rather than being created from nothing, so no conservation law is broken.
architecture.intervention: Replace the "single glass of water forever" claim with a clean-energy vehicle architecture: water/hydrogen is only a carrier, and the required energy is supplied externally (renewable-charged battery or electrolysis powered by solar/wind), with all inputs metered.
architecture.expected_effect: The claimed infinite mileage is removed; vehicle range becomes a bounded function of measured external energy input, satisfying the first and second laws of thermodynamics.
architecture.falsification_test: Run a fixed drive cycle with a full energy audit — log every joule in (battery charge, fuel, heat) and every joule out (wheel work, losses); if usable output work equals or exceeds total input energy, or if the vehicle sustains operation with zero measured external input, the design is falsified as a perpetual-motion claim.

challenge.kill_reason: all deterministic checks passed; the adversarial gauntlet's objections are ESCALATED (uncalibrated attacker, Art. L) and ride the record for adjudication
